jsonld.name: Net Worth Calculator
jsonld.description: Net worth calculator with debt-to-asset ratio, liquid assets, Federal Reserve SCF 2022 age benchmarks and the expected net worth rule of thumb.

mainEntity.name: Should I include my car's value as an asset?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can include it for a complete picture — use its current resale value, not what you paid. Many people leave depreciating items like vehicles out when tracking wealth-building, since they lose value every year.

mainEntity.name: How often should I recalculate my net worth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many people track it quarterly or annually — often enough to see meaningful trends, but not so often that normal market swings feel misleading.

mainEntity.name: What is the median net worth in the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Federal Reserve's 2022 Survey of Consumer Finances, the median US family net worth was $192,900 and the mean was about $1.06 million. The mean is much higher because a small number of very wealthy families pull the average up.

mainEntity.name: Does this calculator show my net worth percentile?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It shows whether you are above or below the Federal Reserve median for your age group, along with the mean. An exact percentile needs the full wealth distribution, which the Fed's age table does not publish.

mainEntity.name: Why is average net worth so much higher than median?

acceptedAnswer.text: A few very wealthy families pull the average up. In the Fed's 2022 data the mean is roughly four times the median in every age group, so the median is the better benchmark.

mainEntity.name: How do I calculate net worth for a couple?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add up the household's combined assets and liabilities and enter your household income. The Fed groups families by the age of the household head, so use the age of the main earner or older partner.

mainEntity.name: Should retirement accounts count at full value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most people count them at face value, but pre-tax balances will be taxed when withdrawn. For a cautious view, subtract an assumed tax rate: $500,000 at 24% is about $380,000 after tax.

mainEntity.name: How accurate is the Millionaire Next Door net worth formula?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a rough guide: age times pre-tax household income divided by 10. It ignores inheritances and windfalls and fits mid-career households better than very young ones.
